repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 30-second sustained wait (300 ticks at 100ms granularity). The candidate uses a 1000ms period and a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire after only 30 seconds of 1-second ticks (30,000ms) but incorrectly counting the initial state as tick 1, leading to an early trigger at 29,000ms. The correct approach uses a 100ms period and a threshold of 301 (30 seconds / 0.1s + 1) to ensure the condition is held for the full 30 seconds before acting.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 100ms and threshold to 301. This aligns the JoI execution grid with the IR's 30-second duration requirement, ensuring the action fires exactly at 30,000ms when the condition has been continuously true for the full duration.
